newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: NWE oil products drift down, but bunkering healthy.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products drift down, but bunkering healthy.

text.p: NWE oil products all softened on Wednesday morning, but promising bunker volumes lifted fuel oil prices from opening lows, dealers said.

High sulphur fuel oil was initially bid at $120 fob ARA, $3 a tonne lower than at Tuesday's close, but signs of improving bunker demand pushed bids up $2. One prompt barge traded at $122.50 fob ARA and a lot for early Nov was sold at $123.25.
Traders said bunker enquiries for the whole ARA region were at around 30,000 tonnes.
"The demand is definitely up and the prices have levelled out," one supplier said.
